description: This file is a PHP script that generates a web page for managing port triggering settings on a network device. It includes PHP code for retrieving configuration data, JavaScript for dynamic UI interactions, and HTML for structure and display.

methods.name: getStr
methods.description: Retrieves a string value from the device configuration using a specified path.

methods.name: getParaValues
methods.description: Fetches parameter values for a given object and parameter list from the device configuration.

methods.name: getInstanceIDs
methods.description: Returns the list of instance IDs for a specified object in the device configuration.
